/lore - open or close the panel (or press your key; press it over an NPC to read about them)
/lore <question> - ask directly, e.g. /lore why is westfall so poor
/lore ask <question> - ask live answers (the answer appears on your screen)
/lore autoplay - narrations as you arrive and quest dialogue on/off
/lore ctx | export | visits | stats - what Lore Forever sees, for bug reports and playtests
/lore journey - what your character has done so far; /lore sync - save it now (reloads)
/lore key - choose the key that opens the panel; /lore key narrate - a key that plays narration
/lore lang - choose the language: English, Deutsch, Español, Français or Português (Automatic follows your WoW client)
/lore library - every recorded narration, grouped (your starting area first)
/lore listen - play the last narrated answer (or where you are); /lore narrate - narrate flights on/off
/lore ondemand - narration only when you press Play on/off
/lore primer - dungeon primer for where you are
/lore quests - every quest you've completed, by zone; click one to read its quest text again
/lore report - tell us the last answer was wrong (or click the cross under any answer)
/lore reset - bring back the panel, the floating player and the minimap button (keeps your journey and settings)
/lore voice - list narration voices; /lore voice <number or name> - switch (auto: default, none: off)
